shouldFix.title: The draft omits the v5 verdict's standing recording-entry advisory and therefore hides why DR-117 remains D-056-ineligible on this candidate alone
shouldFix.finding: The measured Claude v5 verdict has two advisories in its advisories array, which the draft carries, and a separate standingAdvisoryCarriedForward object with id CLAUDE-PPBS-V3-ADV-1. That standing advisory says most v5 enforcement classes are candidate-owned with existingGate none, so the D-056 eligibility property is not met on this contract alone, and explicitly sets its venue to 'the coordinator's recording entry'. Nine v5 classes remain in that shape. D-137 says only that Class A is not opened and carries three other advisory IDs; it does not carry CLAUDE-PPBS-V3-ADV-1 or state that v5 alone is not eligible in kind because the D-056 gate-2/gate-3 remainder mapping is absent. A present-action refusal is not the same planning fact as the verdict's required recording-entry note, especially when a later cycle may otherwise treat dual 0/0 acceptance plus recording as Class-A eligibility.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: The objective D-056 property still governs, the draft does not actually claim eligibility, and it opens no class or status. The omission is an incomplete honesty/advisory transfer and future-planning recital rather than a present authority grant.
shouldFix.repair: Add CLAUDE-PPBS-V3-ADV-1 to the measured Claude-v5 recital and Decision 4's traveling honesty work. State explicitly that recording v5 does not make DR-117 D-056-eligible in kind on v5 alone: the candidate-owned/no-exact-DR-G classes do not establish Eligibility gates 2 and 3, so any later SATISFIED cycle must first close and independently review that owner/gate/harness design rather than treating this recording as application-grade Class A. Keep DR-117 OPEN, Class A unopened, and readiness unchanged.

After a dependent act lands, require that act's owning-entry supersession or revert plus reconciliation of every dependent file-08/COORD record under its own separately reviewed act.
